## 9fe97c2dd8a4

**Reproduced teaching shortcut.** The five-phase default curriculum ties the repeated-length branch to the first bar row strongly enough that the executable rival “apply the duplicate-length adjustment only when the first bar begins on row 1” fits all four demonstrations yet predicts a different query answer. The smallest retained witness is easy band, seed 1, demo sample indices 0–3, query index 4. All five inputs pass `self_check`; the declared `lesson_identifiable` hook returns no reasons; the supported Racket runner matches the Python authority; and the rival differs on the query (`checks/audit/9fe97c2dd8a4/row-start-shortcut.json`, `racket.json`).

A 100-seed × 5-start × 3-band census found 91 answer-changing teaching defects among 1,500 cyclic lessons; all 91 were accepted by `lesson_identifiable`. The rival survived all demos in 1,136/1,500 lessons (`checks/audit/9fe97c2dd8a4/row-start-shortcut-census.json`). No target files were changed.

**Independent test portability issue.** The selected task-test stage reports 24 passes and 2 failures because `test_generator_9fe97c2dd8a4.py` looks for canonical data under the staged generator directory instead of using the portable canonical-data helper. Evidence: `checks/audit/9fe97c2dd8a4/task-tests/result.json`. This is separate from the semantic shortcut.

## 9fe97c2dd8a4

**No generator semantic issue found in the tested domain.** Generator SHA-256
`33cef6801dbee98be442d197810d1a3e604c046bfdd1b544a29f0da18d62e381`
declares the canonical-training shortcut `include_color_5_in_duplicate_census`
and a five-profile schedule. I enumerated 250 four-demo cyclic lessons per band
(seeds `0..49`, starts `0..4`): 750/750 were identifiable, zero lessons retained
the declared rival, and 1,126 unique inputs were observed across bands. The six
curriculum-contract tests also pass. Evidence:
`checks/audit/9fe97c2dd8a4/lesson-probe.json` and
`checks/audit/9fe97c2dd8a4/curriculum-pytest.log`.

A separate portability issue was preserved rather than hidden: the supported
portable task-test run passes 24 tests but fails two because
`test_generator_9fe97c2dd8a4.py` resolves canonical data as
`generators/9fe97c2dd8a4/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`, which is absent in the
snapshot. This is a test-path/infrastructure defect, not evidence against the
sampler; see `checks/audit/9fe97c2dd8a4/task-tests-command.log`.

The clean semantic conclusion is finite: it covers the declared rival, profile
schedule, specified seed range, and cyclic assembly policy, not every imaginable
alternative rule.
